lens 0.1->0.0
  out: {
    out.init <- in.init
  }
lens 0.2->0.1
  out: {
    out.init <- in.init
    if in.optional != _|_ {
      out.optional <- in.optional
    }
  }
lens 0.3->0.2
  out: {
    out.init <- in.init
    if in.optional != _|_ {
      out.optional <- in.optional
    }
    if in.withDefault != _|_ {
      if in.withDefault != "baz" {
        out.withDefault <- in.withDefault
      }
      if in.withDefault == "baz" {
        out.withDefault = "foo"
      }
    }
  }
  lacuna LossyFieldMapping {
    when (in.withDefault & "baz") != _|_
    source withDefault = in.withDefault
    target withDefault = out.withDefault
    message "withDefault was \"baz\", which 0.2 does not have; \"foo\", its default, was substituted"
  }
